Missing Corrugated Sheets Replaced

The photo at the top of this page is one of our repairs, shown before and after: a corrugated roof with sheets missing, and the same roof with new sheets fitted in the gaps.

A Strip Opened Up Near the Ridge

On this bungalow a strip of tiles came off just below the ridge. New red membrane went in underneath before the tiles were laid back, with ladders up the front for the job.

Tiles, Slate and Sheet Roofs

Our repair photos so far are on a tiled bungalow and a corrugated sheet roof, and the same team strips, felts, battens and re-covers whole roofs in concrete tile and in slate. So whatever your roof is covered in, it's work the team already does on every re-roof.

Signs It Needs Looking At

These are general signs, not a diagnosis. If you spot one, call or send us a photo and we'll tell you what we think.

  • A damp patch on a ceiling after rain
  • Tiles or slates on the lawn or the drive
  • A ridge tile that has come loose
  • Sheets lifted or missing on a garage or outbuilding roof

Useful to Tell Us About the Damage

  • Where the leak or damage is, and when you first noticed it
  • Whether the roof is tiles, slate or sheets
  • A photo of the damage, if you can take one safely from the ground
